_comment: Lisa's feedback file — the ONLY file Prospector reads for feedback. Hand-edited; committed to the repo so it survives every run. Add one object per role to "entries". Identify a role EITHER by its exact "key" (copy it from feedback_template_lisa.json, which is regenerated every run) OR by "company" + "title" together, which is easier to type. "note" and "date" are free text for your own reference and are never parsed.

_statuses.applied: You applied. Never recommended again; shows under Hiring Progress once the posting disappears.
_statuses.already_applied: You had already applied elsewhere. Suppressed from recommendations.
_statuses.too_technical: Too technical for you. Suppressed, and counted as a false positive in the weekly audit.
_statuses.wrong_function: Wrong function. Suppressed, and counted as a false positive.
_statuses.wrong_industry: Wrong industry. Suppressed, and counted as a false positive.
_statuses.interested: Keep showing it until it closes or ages out. NOT suppressed.
